title: Task Timer
description: Show the session's agent working time (the dashboard's own model plus tool time, less the time spent waiting for your answers) as a clock-led pill in the conversation dashboard, with the span from the session's creation to its last activity when opened — capped there, so an idle conversation stops counting — plus the excluded answer wait (the dialog shares the built-in turns/steps stylesheet), and the total time used across all conversations above the sidebar account row as "1h29m · Conversation total".
